objects.description: [Storm-0501](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1053) has used Windows native utility [Nltest](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0359), e.g. `nltest.exe`, for discovery.(Citation: Microsoft Storm-501 Sabbath Ransomware Embargo September 2024)
